Package Client

Class ClientUI

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
Client.ClientUI
public class ClientUI extends Application
The main entry point for the client-side application. This class handles the JavaFX lifecycle, manages the primary stage, establishes the connection to the server, and tracks application idle time.
